rules.D1: Detection: full marks within 3 s of the first radar paint, zero at 20 s.
rules.C1: Identification: correct = 18 + 12 × confidence; wrong = 10 × (1 − confidence), +5 if friend/foe was right.
rules.R2: Bird or clutter → hold; don't waste an effector.
rules.R4: No radio link, GNSS-guided → GNSS spoof or interceptor.
rules.R5: Engage the most urgent threat first.
rules.R6: Gun in an urban area → collateral risk.
rules.R7: Engage with at least 8 s to impact.
rules.R8: A hostile must not reach the asset or observe unchallenged.
rules.R9: Unknown civil drone: report and monitor; do not engage.
rules.R10: After a miss, engage again before impact.
rules.R11: Jamming/spoofing in an EW-restricted area disrupts own and civil systems.
rules.R12: Kinetic or EW engagement without clearance under this ROE.
rules.G1: Gun safety: fire only on an Engage order with the range clear; firing on Hold or Check fire is a critical failure.
rules.G2: Make ready on the fire order: acknowledge, load, safety off, then lay on the designated bearing.
rules.G3: Clear a stoppage with the immediate-action drill; do not fire a barrel past its heat limit.
rules.G4: Fire the first burst quickly after the Engage order.
rules.G5: Ballistic solution: manual sight set for the target's speed, course and range; radar gun fired only on a lock.
rules.G6: Burst accuracy: each burst is scored by how close it passes the target.
rules.G7: Destroy the target before it reaches the defended asset.
rules.G8: Burst discipline: short bursts within effective range; no ammunition wasted.
rules.G9: After cease fire: safety on, unload, clear the gun and account for every round.
rules.G10: Safe arcs: never fire into a safe arc (village, own troops, airfield approach).
rules.G11: Kill assessment: report the result of each engagement (destroyed, or no effect and re-engage).
rules.F1: Alert the detachment and indicate the target promptly once a threat is tracked.
rules.F2: Fire orders follow the sequence Alert, Target, Method, Executive; no executive word without the earlier parts.
rules.F3: Weapon Control Status: under Tight engage only identified hostiles; under Hold only in self-defence; never a friendly or civil aircraft.
rules.F4: Do not order fire while the target is inside a safe arc.
rules.F5: Engage the threat with the least time to the asset first.
rules.F6: Give the executive order once the target is inside the gun's effective range.
rules.F7: Cease fire when the target is destroyed; Hold fire at once when a friendly or civil aircraft enters the line of fire.
rules.F8: After the engagement: Cease fire, then Unload; record the result of every target.
